name: What metrics should a CPA firm track to measure the success of AI SEO?
description: Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, qualified leads, conversion rates, and local search visibility to measure AI SEO success for your CPA firm.

mainEntity.name: What metrics should a CPA firm track to measure the success of AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure the success of AI SEO, CPA firms should track several key performance indicators. These include increases in organic search traffic to their website, improved keyword rankings for relevant accounting terms, and a higher number of qualified leads generated through online channels. Other important metrics are conversion rates from website visitors to clients, bounce rate, time spent on pages, and local search visibility for geographically targeted services. Monitoring these metrics provides a clear picture of how AI SEO is contributing to business growth and return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, qualified leads, conversion rates, and local search visibility to measure AI SEO success for your CPA firm.
